Igushik River MCMC Output (Brood Years 1963-2017)

Source: R/data-docs.R
post_Igushik_byr63_15.Rd

Similar to post_Igushik_byr63_05 but using an extended brood-year series through 2017. These posterior samples allow evaluation of escapement goals using the full contemporary brood table.

post_Igushik_byr63_15

Format

A data frame with one row per MCMC draw and columns:

beta

Density dependence parameter.

deviance

Deviance measure used for MCMC diagnostics.

e0

Initial 'residual' for autoregressive model.

lnalpha

Log-scale productivity parameter.

phi

Temporal autocorrelation parameter.

sigma

Process or observation error standard deviation.

Source

Igushik River stock-recruit model (brood years 1963-2015).

Details

Posterior samples are used to generate stock-recruit curves, calculate SMSY, and derive Optimal Yield Profiles (OYP). This dataset is nearly identical to post_Igushik_byr63_05 but based on an expanded brood year range. Used to demonstrate updating a dataset to evaluate historic vs. modern productivity.

Examples
